proposed_facts.reason: Canonical state-4 counter and bounce_y consumption support the distinguishing name; rendered evidence independently exposes the existing name collision.
Initializer writes agree with the declared six-byte record: current frame zero, end frame 30. Result metadata and transforms are outside the reset writes.
Definitions and consumers establish six thresholds yielding results 0–6, character-icon lookup use, and runtime sampling of 41 Y values at frames 10–50.
The complete ordering tree assigns a permutation and contains the stated asymmetric final comparison; the caller imports generated standings into MatchEnd.
Verified weight sums, the slot-2 comparison awarding slot 1 standing 2, and copying all four standings into both result bytes before selecting zero.
Every terminal path assigns distinct standings after three draws. The exceptional weight-to-recipient association is preserved rather than normalized.
Pointer strides and typed offsets confirm the exact partial initialization and identify 0x1E as end frame, not a timer.
Unwritten fields survive the reset; result resolution and outcome construction precede the final reset in result initialization.
The complete handler does not use arg1. Its caller supplies fn_8018F674(4), while the held-button wrapper is distinct; arg2 comes from the triggered-button wrapper.
Verified audio transitions, text-counter increments and clamp, x18-zero behavior, terminal guards, and the progression-rank writer. The timeout correction matches canonical behavior.
Reset and setup dispatch match the proposal. Both stage-policy predicates consult x32 only for policies 0 and 2.

contradictions.reason: The generic slot callback name collides with a different visibility callback. Accept the bounce-specific replacement without inferring artwork identity.
Accept all three compiled-section deferrals: aggregate definitions, static initializers and MUST_MATCH helpers do not establish compiled .bss exclusivity, .sdata adjacency or .sdata2 ordering.
The aggregate state claim and both initializer claims incorrectly characterized the 30 value or reset extent. Accept the corrections to end=30, cur=0 and partial preservation.
Accept correction of the six-step and initialized-curve characterization: classification has seven possible numeric results and bounce samples are written at runtime.

Accept all three ordering corrections. The permutation invariant remains supported, but universal weight-proportional sampling is contradicted by the slot-0-first/slot-3-second branch. Reference-game equivalence remains deferred.
Accept removal of held_inputs from the unused second argument: caller and wrapper definitions do not support that semantic label.
Accept presentation-counter and progression-rank corrections. A 7200 counter threshold is not a universal elapsed-frame timeout.
Accept qualification of the one-time-selection claim: policies 1 and 3 ignore x32, unlike policies 0 and 2.

unresolved: Compiled section placement, exclusivity, adjacency and literal ordering remain unverified; the three upstream deferrals are accepted.
The canonical ordering asymmetry is established, but its reference-game provenance remains unknown.
Preserve inherited uncertainties concerning selected-slot and exhausted-bracket validity, artwork identities, numeric-state meanings, lbl_804D6678 and the fn_80198584 callback-type ambiguity.

x32 prevents repeated selection only for policies 0 and 2; policies 1 and 3 ignore it.
